features.name: NER Entity Extraction
features.description: Extract named entities from draft text using GLiNER API

tests.notes: Tests cover Pioneer payload normalization plus entity post-processing for short-token filtering and initialism deduplication.

features.notes: Entity output is post-processed before vector search to remove noisy short tokens and abbreviation duplicates such as WBW versus Wait But Why.

features.name: Sentence Embedding Generation
features.description: Generate embeddings using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 local model

tests.notes: Tests for embed_text and batch embedding

features.name: Qdrant Vector Search
features.description: Search for semantically similar article chunks via Qdrant

tests.notes: Tests cover local and hosted client creation plus normalized search result mapping

features.notes: Configured for local Qdrant by default during development while preserving hosted deployment support via optional API key.

features.name: Equity-Aware Re-ranking
features.description: Re-rank candidates based on similarity and link equity need

tests.notes: Tests cover equity_need, final_score, URL-level candidate collapse, exclusion of already-selected URLs, and final score ordering.

features.notes: Reranking now collapses duplicate chunk hits down to one best candidate per URL before scoring, which prevents a single article from occupying multiple slots during recommendation generation.

features.name: Sitemap Crawl and Ingest
features.description: Crawl sitemap, extract article text, chunk and upsert to Qdrant

tests.notes: Tests cover internal link extraction, inbound link graph construction, and sitemap ingest graph initialization.

features.notes: Sitemap ingestion now reuses crawled HTML to extract outbound internal links and initialize real inbound link counts for equity-aware reranking.

features.name: Recommend API Endpoint
features.description: POST /api/v1/recommend - analyze text and return link recommendations

tests.notes: Integration tests with mocked core modules cover min_similarity forwarding, widened retrieval depth, and URL-diverse recommendations across multiple entities.

features.notes: Recommend requests now query a wider candidate pool, rerank at the URL level, and avoid repeating the same destination URL within a single response unless new URLs are exhausted.

features.name: Ingest API Endpoint
features.description: POST /api/v1/ingest - ingest single article into vector store

features.name: Health Check Endpoint
features.description: GET /api/v1/health - returns service status and model loaded state

tests.notes: Tests for config defaults and env var loading

features.name: Logging System
features.description: Custom logger with file output and structured logging

tests.notes: Tests for logger output and formatting

features.name: API Usage Documentation
features.description: Document endpoint usage, payloads, and examples for local API consumers
features.notes: README now links to the dedicated API guide for request examples and response shapes.

features.name: Distributed Systems Performance (Latency) Evaluation
features.description: Measure total round-trip time from Vercel request to JSON response across 50 sequential calls. Target: under 3 seconds. Instrumentation logs each pipeline segment (GLiNER, embedding, Qdrant, reranking) independently to identify bottlenecks.

tests.notes: Performance evaluation script with timing instrumentation

features.notes: Eval 1 from design.md - latency benchmark against 3-second target. Run with: python -m backend.eval.eval_latency

features.name: Link Equity Distribution (Graph Health) Evaluation
features.description: Measure how intelligently the system distributes link equity across the site compared to pure similarity baseline. Run 50 drafts through baseline (α=1.0) and equity-aware (α=0.7) configs. Compute orphan reduction rate and Gini coefficient - equity-aware should achieve lower Gini and higher orphan reduction while maintaining >90% semantic accuracy.

tests.notes: Tests cover projected full-graph Gini calculation plus orphan rescue measurement against the original inbound-link graph.

features.notes: Eval 4 now fetches the server's active link graph, lowers min_similarity during evaluation to expose a wider rerank candidate pool, and computes distribution metrics on the projected full graph after simulated recommendations.

features.name: Frontend Landing and Navigation Shell
features.description: Add a branded landing page plus in-app navigation between home, workspace, and FAQ views.

tests.notes: UI flow covered by manual verification via production build; no component-level automated navigation tests yet.

features.notes: Header tabs and the avatar dropdown now navigate to the landing page, analyzer workspace, FAQ glossary, and backend API docs. Homepage CTAs also share a common base style so primary and secondary actions render with consistent sizing.

features.name: Frontend FAQ Glossary
features.description: Provide a dedicated FAQ page that explains core internal-linking and semantic-search terms used throughout the product.

tests.notes: Content-oriented UI with no dedicated automated rendering tests yet.

features.notes: The glossary includes terms such as embeddings, orphan pages, link equity, GLiNER, Qdrant, and DRY_RUN.

features.name: Recommendation-to-Highlight Linking
features.description: When a recommendation card is selected, pulse and scroll the editor highlight into view for the matching phrase.

tests.notes: Automated tests cover stable highlight markup generation and safe phrase-key encoding used by the scroll linking behavior.

features.notes: Highlight rendering now uses encoded phrase keys so the workspace can reliably locate matching marks before smooth-scrolling them into view.

features.name: Link Graph Inspection Endpoint
features.description: Expose the active inbound-link graph so evaluation and debugging tools can inspect the server's current equity state.

tests.notes: Async route test verifies the endpoint returns the current rerank link graph and URL count.

features.notes: GET /api/v1/link-graph returns the in-memory inbound-link counts used by the reranker, which keeps the equity eval aligned with the API process instead of a disconnected local module import.

features.name: AI Precision (LLM-as-a-Judge) Evaluation
features.description: Use Groq as an LLM judge to score whether each recommendation is semantically accurate and highly helpful, with separate reporting for ambiguity tripwire cases.

tests.notes: Tests cover Groq structured-output format selection, richer judge prompt construction, and SDK-based verdict parsing.

features.notes: Eval 2 now uses the official Groq Python SDK, falls back to JSON object mode for unsupported models, and enriches judgment with cached target-page excerpts plus source focus context.

features.name: Frontend Sitemap Management Page
features.description: Add a dedicated frontend view that shows whether sitemap-backed URLs are currently loaded and lets the user submit a new sitemap XML crawl directly from the UI.

tests.notes: Service-level tests cover env-driven API URL construction, sitemap status mapping from the link-graph endpoint, and direct sitemap ingest request payloads.

features.notes: The page infers active sitemap status from the current indexed link graph, offers a direct XML URL submission flow to POST /api/v1/ingest/sitemap, and now reads the backend API base URL from the repo-root .env via Vite so local or hosted backend targets can be swapped without source edits.
